notes: BUU 2.0 v2.2.8 - fixes the Frankware order scrape so the first three CSV columns (PP Location Code, PP Invoice #, Frankware Property #) fill in. In v2.2.7 those three fields were read as raw text, so a {{Column}} token entered there was looked up literally and came back blank; they now resolve {{Column}} tokens the same way the URL field does (and still accept a bare column name). The three fields are also token-droppable in the step UI now. Existing saved Frankware scrape flows need no edits - the tokens already in those fields resolve correctly on the next run.
